editorial:
Imagine having to leave everything you know behind just to survive, carrying nothing but a dream to keep you going. You follow two sisters, Yusra and Sara, who flee the war in Syria to find a safe home in Europe. It starts out feeling like a tense survival story, but it quickly turns into something much more hopeful. You will feel the bond between the sisters as they face scary situations and fight through impossible odds, all while trying to keep their passion for swimming alive. It is a real-life story that hits you right in the heart without feeling too heavy.

The acting is great and makes you really care about what happens to these girls. The scenes in the water are especially intense and will keep you on the edge of your seat. While some parts of the plot feel a bit rushed, the emotional payoff is totally worth it. You should definitely watch this if you love stories about overcoming the odds.
endingExplained: The movie ends with Yusra finally achieving her dream of competing in the 2016 Rio Olympics. After fighting through danger and loss, she represents the Refugee Olympic Team. You see her swim in the big pool, showing the world her strength. While she does not win a gold medal, the real victory is that she survived and made it there. The story wraps up by celebrating her courage and the help she received along the way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories about bravery and family.
